Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4028801. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES, allowing nulls for missing structures. Return all rows without deduplication. Sort the results by molecule ChEMBL ID in ascending order.
